paras: Application: 2016+ Honda Civic (all), including FL5 Civic Type R Part Type: Fuel filter mount Part Number: 20-1086

The Radium 20-1086 is the hardware for installing a Radium fuel filter on a 2016+ Honda Civic. One half of the billet aluminium clamp secures to the LH fuel tank mounting tab, replacing the OEM screw with a stainless steel flat head screw, and the opposing half secures the fuel filter with stainless steel screws.
hl: OEM Mounting: Mounts to the OEM threaded hole on the LH fuel tank tab
Billet Clamps: Billet anodised aluminium clamps, 60mm (2.36in) diameter
FL5 Type R: Second countersink hole provides clearance on the FL5 fuel tank
Stainless Hardware: Stainless steel screws throughout
Anodised aluminium fuel filter mount (two-piece clamp)
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Filter Mount for Honda Civic 2016+
